name: FunctionGemma greeting sanity
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--functiongemma-270m-it/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && printf "Hello\n" | timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin 1000 950 48 > /tmp/fcgreet.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/fcgreet.log | cut -c1-60 | head -10'
